apis.title: Runtime for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation

x: Every model id is answered by one small local model (llama.cpp on the appliance, WebLLM on Nano when the browser provides it): quality is toy-grade. No local model running -> ModelNotReadyException, never a canned answer. Tool use, images, guardrails and prompt caching are rejected with a validation error rather than ignored. Streaming is real event framing over a response generated whole.

features.t: Knowledge bases (S3 data sources, ingestion, Retrieve, RetrieveAndGenerate)
x: Ingestion really reads the S3 data source, chunks (fixed size / none) and embeds with the local embedding seam; Retrieve is exact cosine kNN with metadata filters. Only text documents (.txt/.md/.csv/.json/.html/.xml/.log) are ingested - PDF/Office files are reported as failed. The vector store type named at creation is recorded but the index always lives in the account (no OpenSearch/Pinecone/etc). Without an embedding model on the backend, vyomi-hash-embed (a deterministic bag-of-words embedding) is used, so retrieval is lexical-ish, not semantic. Every model id is answered by one small local model (llama.cpp on the appliance, WebLLM on Nano when the browser provides it): quality is toy-grade. No local model running -> ModelNotReadyException, never a canned answer.

features.t: Agents (create, prepare, aliases, knowledge bases, InvokeAgent)
x: Agent versions/aliases snapshot the prepared agent; InvokeAgent prompts the local model with the instruction, session history and retrieved knowledge-base passages and returns citations. Action groups are stored but never invoked (a <1 GB model does not emit reliable tool calls); no orchestration trace, guardrails, memory or multi-agent collaboration. Every model id is answered by one small local model (llama.cpp on the appliance, WebLLM on Nano when the browser provides it): quality is toy-grade. No local model running -> ModelNotReadyException, never a canned answer.

Gateways expose a real MCP JSON-RPC endpoint (initialize, tools/list, tools/call) at POST /gateways/{id}/mcp on the Vyomi wire, not at the *.gateway.bedrock-agentcore hostname. Lambda targets are really invoked. openApiSchema/smithyModel/mcpServer targets are registered but their tools are not callable; CUSTOM_JWT tokens are not validated (only presence of an Authorization header is checked); no semantic tool search or credential-provider (OAuth/API key) flows.

Runtimes are control-plane records (create/get/list/update/delete with versions and CREATING->READY). The simulator does not run runtime containers, so InvokeAgentRuntime returns a RuntimeClientError. Memory, identity and observability sub-services are not simulated.
